response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM acct), diffs AS (SELECT acct.account_id, acct.region, acct.order_count, acct.order_count - overall.avg_count AS diff FROM acct, overall), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY region) SELECT diffs.account_id, diffs.region, diffs.order_count, diffs.diff, diffs.diff - region_avg.region_avg_diff AS excess FROM diffs JOIN region_avg ON diffs.region = region_avg.region WHERE diffs.diff > region_avg.region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
